notes.title: Cthulhu pub is out!
notes.notes: I was working on new content during March and April. Then I focused on the technical side. A lot of bugs were fixed and a lot of changes have been made. I was hoping the Early access could be finished in a month or two, but it took a longer distance. I hope you'll like the game. Thank you!

notes.title: Build and grow!
notes.notes:
In this update, I added:
[list]
[*]New walls: Old drawn walls, town cozy walls
[*]Rooftops: Old gothic rooftop, Fresh cozy rooftop
[*]One new decoration floor: Road floor surface
[*]Multiple floors up to 4 floors
[*]New farms: Meat farm and vegetable farm
[/list]
Hope you'll like this update. Cheers!

notes.title: GOD Types and Pause menu
notes.notes:
In this update, I added 3 types of Gods: Red, Green, Gold.

Also Altars splitter into 3 kinds: 
[list]
[*]Red - Slows down God's encounter and gives 5 meat when gets destroyed by the God
[*]Green - Slows down God's encounter and gives 5 vegetables when gets destroyed by the God
[*]Gold - Slows down God's encounter and gives 5 gold when gets destroyed by the God
[/list]

Pause menu:
You can pause the game now and speed up gameplay. 

Hope you'll like the update! 
Cheers!

notes.title: Cthulhu pub and Russian invasion
notes.notes: Hi! This is Marginal act a game developer from Ukraine. I decided to release Cthulhu pub today because I don't know what will be with me, my game, and my country tomorrow due to Russian aggression. Right now my city is under massive bombing attack. Ukrainian troops are fighting bravely and I hope we will survive this war. If you want to support me just buy the game it relatively chips on release. Please support NGOs in Ukraine, go on the protest against the war, and pray for Ukraine.
